query_snapshot: What does NASA SP-8119 recommend consulting when selecting dissimilar metals for parts that touch, and what risk is this intended to address?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 recommends consulting the electrochemical series for metals when selecting materials that will touch (dissimilar metals). [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- The purpose of consulting the electrochemical series is to address electrochemical (galvanic) corrosion between dissimilar metals in contact. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
